newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch AEX share index breaks through 1,000 barrier.
newsitem.headline: Dutch AEX share index breaks through 1,000 barrier.

text.p: The AEX Dutch share index broke through the 1,000 points mark for the first time on Wednesday, opening 45.64 points higher at 1,006.26.
The index soon dropped back just below the 1,000 mark but was still up over three percent, having already gained over three percent on Tuesday.

Dealers attributed the rise to remarks by U.S. Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan who sent Wall Street soaring to a record high on Tuesday by indicating that American interest rates would not rise soon.
